questions.stem_text: Which of the following is an incorrect statement about gel electrophoresis?

options.A: DNA migrates from positive charge to negative charge.
options.C: The DNA migrates only when the current is running.
options.D: The longer the current is running, the farther the DNA will travel.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - DNA migrates from positive charge to negative charge.

questions.stem_text:
Vinegar is classified as an acid. What does this tell you about the concentration of the
hydrogen ions and the hydroxide ions?

options.A: Vinegar has a lower concentration of hydrogen ions than hydroxide ions
options.B: Vinegar has an excess of hydrogen ions with respect to hydroxide ions
options.C: Vinegar has a higher concentration of hydroxide ions than water
options.E: Vinegar does not contain hydrogen ions

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - Vinegar has an excess of hydrogen ions with respect to hydroxide ions
